Message privacy

Standard messaging is server-readable. HTTPS protects traffic in transit and account permissions control access. The service stores readable message text. Standard DMs, groups and community channels are not end-to-end encrypted.

Encrypted messaging is a separate Matrix service. When configured and verified, supported clients encrypt content using maintained Matrix cryptography. A VOIDLINE account or lock icon alone does not establish encryption. The interface identifies the actual mode and never silently moves an encrypted send to Standard messaging.

Existing Standard history, recipients' copies, screenshots and plaintext exports remain outside a later encrypted conversation. Operators can observe metadata such as identifiers, membership, timing and traffic size. Browser code and an unlocked device are trusted endpoints.

Native restrictions and Matrix restrictions are distinct until their server-side integration is complete. Blocking someone does not automatically remove that person's access to a shared encrypted room.

Account data and storage

VOIDLINE stores account identifiers, password hashes, memberships, profiles, messages, consented friendships, reports and legitimate cosmetic ownership. Passwords use salted Argon2id; the owner dashboard does not reveal passwords or usable recovery secrets.

Profile and collection details follow their visibility settings. Recovery email and authentication-provider details stay private. Request metadata supports operation and abuse controls. Optional browser push uses generic previews: the push provider receives encrypted notification payloads and delivery metadata, not message text.

Saved labels distinguish synced Standard bookmarks, encrypted messaging references and encrypted notes kept only on this device. Bookmarks do not bypass conversation permissions. A local vault is not a cloud backup. Profile images follow current visibility and blocking rules. Standard attachments and voice recordings are private server-stored files; they have the same service-readable boundary as Standard text.

Account deletion revokes native credentials and anonymizes retained authors. Other participants' legitimate history can remain. Configured Matrix account deactivation is queued separately and can remain pending if the service is unavailable. External backups have separate lifecycles. In Settings → Data, choose a specific export scope and confirm that the JSON download is readable plaintext. Exports omit authentication secrets, Matrix keys and messages, device-only Saved notes, and uploaded file bytes.

Three kinds of recovery

  • Account: your one-time recovery code can reset the login password. Save it in your password manager. Email recovery requires configured delivery and a verified recovery address.
  • Encrypted history: trusted devices and the messaging recovery key protect access. A password reset does not restore missing message keys.
  • Local Saved: device-only notes use their own vault. Matrix backup and email recovery do not automatically restore it.

If every trusted device and relevant recovery secret is lost, protected history may be unrecoverable. Recovery never reveals an old password. Support does not need you to post passwords, device tokens or recovery keys publicly.

Using VOIDLINE

Use accounts you control and invitations you may share. Do not harass members, evade blocks, impersonate administrators, misuse private content or interfere with the service. Community roles apply within their community; they do not grant platform administration.

Current badges, gifts and decorations are free cosmetics. They do not represent money, investments, verified token balances, official affiliation or administrative powers. Ownership follows actual server records; copied artwork and changed browser storage do not award official items.

Availability, retention and provider dependencies are described in the app and delivery notes. Optional profile effects must remain readable for people using reduced motion, keyboard navigation or a readable theme.

Support and reports

Use in-app reporting for abuse. Review selected text and context first: a report deliberately shares that evidence with an authorized moderator. Encryption does not grant moderators a universal reading key.

For software problems, use the public issue tracker. Describe the action and error. Other people can read public issues, so omit private messages, email addresses, passwords and recovery material.

The improvement brief and project source describe current delivery. Security claims depend on completed integration and verification.
